findings.quote: I assumed the ratio counts one two three
findings.note: The phrase spells out option 3's own value, 1:2:3, in words. The brief bans a route that names the value of an option: a student who circled that option can match the route to the answer they picked instead of recalling how they got there, and a guesser is then recorded as having made a concept error.
findings.fix: I assumed the distance grows by a fixed step

notes: S1:S2:S3 = 5:15:25 = 1:3:5 confirmed, and 1:4:9 is indeed the ratio of the totals, so mistakes[2] typed application (right concept, wrong quantity - totals instead of per-second) is right and its route matches. mistakes[0] concept is right. right_route (I used the nth second formula for free fall) is step 1, 9 words, and 'nth second formula' is ordinary Class-11 vocabulary. The proposed fix stays distinguishable from mistakes[0].route (equal distance each second is no growth at all, versus growth by a fixed step).
